title: Nourishing Japanese Vegetable Pilaf
description: A light and refreshing macrobiotic-friendly dish featuring a mirepoix base and spicy red pepper flakes, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer and drain well
In a medium saucepan, combine the rice and water and bring to a boil over high heat
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes
While the rice cooks, heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat
Add the diced carrots, onions, and celery and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender
Add the red pepper flakes, salt, and rehydrated wakame seaweed to the skillet and stir to combine
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the cooked vegetable mixture
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional wakame seaweed if desired
